headerDisplay:
This plugin creates three stateless switches: **Disarm Somfy Protect**, **Arm Somfy Protect for Away**, and **Arm Somfy Protect for Night**. They call the Somfy Protect plugin's local HTTP API, making all three alarm states available to HomeKit automations.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT:** Install `@jay-d-tyler/homebridge-somfy-protect` version 2.3.0 or later. It must expose `POST /disarm`, `POST /arm/away`, and `POST /arm/night` on its configured HTTP port. Both plugins can run on child bridges.

🔒 **SECURITY:** Configure the same strong HTTP token in both plugins.

⚠️ **PORT NOTE:** Use port 8582 (default). Port 8581 is normally reserved for Homebridge Config UI.
footerDisplay: 💡 **Tip:** Make sure the HTTP port and token match what you configured in the Somfy Protect plugin settings, and keep its HTTP host on the default `127.0.0.1`.

httpToken.title: HTTP API Token
httpToken.description: The authentication token configured in the Somfy Protect plugin. Both values must match.
